Academic freeware and open-source scientific libraries, in Julia and in C++.

## MicroPoroChemoMechanics

![](images/logo_org.svg){.jfb-page-logo}

**[MicroPoroChemoMechanics](software/mpcm.qmd)** is a GitHub organization of which I am one
of the owners. It gathers a Julia ecosystem for the coupled micro-chemo-mechanics of porous
reactive media, from molecular-level thermodynamic equilibrium up to the macroscopic
poromechanical response. The five packages are registered in Julia's General registry and
install with a plain `Pkg.add`.
